purpose: Test comprehension, recall and reported cognitive load for matched control versus pattern-informed versions of the 18 provisional communication-job cards.
claim_boundary: A result can show differences in the measured task for the authored stimuli and tested population. It cannot establish that a celebrity's delivery or a speech form causes trust, long-term memory, persuasion, engagement or action generally.

patterns.communication_job: Give the listener a reason and orientation for the exchange.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: Name the room or question; state why it matters; preview the route.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: End without leaving the main point or next step diffuse.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: Return to the point; name the limit or next step; release the turn.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: Invite inquiry, reflection or a useful next turn.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: Ask one specific question; give context; allow a genuine answer or opt-out.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: Respond to the literal prompt while addressing the underlying need.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: Answer the literal point; state a useful frame if needed; give the bounded answer.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: Make an idea concrete without turning one life into universal proof.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: Give a bounded scene; say what it changed or illustrates; state what it cannot prove.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: Give a general claim a concrete handle without presenting an illustration as proof.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: State the claim; give one representative case; return to the claim and its evidence boundary.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: Make a distinction or change in reasoning visible without escalating disagreement.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: Name the earlier view; identify what changed; state the present view and remaining overlap.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: Move from an unhelpful starting frame to a more useful question or category.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: Acknowledge the starting frame; explain the correction; answer the more useful question.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: Restore accuracy or shared understanding after an error, interruption or unclear phrase.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: Mark the error; replace it plainly; continue without over-explaining.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: State a clear point while marking uncertainty, scope or conditions.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: State the main claim; name its evidence status or condition; say what would change it.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: Make an unfamiliar idea usable without overextending it.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: Name the term; give its plain meaning; show one example and one boundary.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: Help a listener follow a change of topic, scale, speaker or reasoning step.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: Close the current point; name the relationship; enter the next point.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: Give a long exchange continuity or let an earlier image carry changed meaning.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: Introduce a meaningful anchor; return to it with a new application; avoid merely repeating it.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: Create ease or relational room without making affected people the joke.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: Use lightness about your own situation or the shared setting; return clearly to the point.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: Make contribution, support or dependence visible without turning praise into a status performance.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: Name the contribution; connect it to the result; state what remains owed or unfinished.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: Turn a broad aspiration into a voluntary, bounded next role.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: Name the problem; offer a specific action and responsible actor; state the limit and consent path.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: Move a room toward judgment or action while showing evidence, tradeoffs and responsibility.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: State the stake; show the mechanism; name tradeoffs and accountable actors; invite a bounded choice.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

patterns.communication_job: Connect an event or decision to a value without pretending the value settles the facts.
patterns.pattern_informed_form: Describe the event; name the value it raises; distinguish interpretation from verified fact.
patterns.stimulus_requirement: one newly authored matched pair; same proposition, topic, vocabulary, modality and length range; no source-speaker identity

listener_tasks.prompt: State the speaker's main point in your own words without seeing the script.
Name the example, reason or evidence the speaker used, if any.
State one limit, uncertainty or condition included by the speaker, or say that none was clear.
What action or role, if any, did the speaker invite? Include owner or condition if stated.
Report what was confusing, rushed, emotionally difficult or easy to follow; agreement is not required.
After a defined delay, restate the main point and one supporting detail.
listener_tasks.measure: blind rubric score 0–2; only when feasible and consented

design.comparison: randomized matched control versus pattern-informed version
design.assignment: randomize version and pattern order; keep scorer blind to condition where practical
design.holdout: Lock a new authored stimulus set before unblinding and reserve some pairs for holdout.

controls: Keep proposition, topic, vocabulary, length and modality matched.
Do not use source celebrity identity or copied quotations as the manipulation.
Pretest readability, captions, audio levels and accessibility.
Record topic familiarity and agreement separately from comprehension.
Do not treat liking, trust or agreement as comprehension proxies.
consent_and_accessibility: Use plain-language consent and allow withdrawal without penalty.
Offer text, captioned audio/video and screen-reader-compatible response modes.
Do not require trauma, medical, political or personal disclosure.
Minimize retention of recordings; obtain separate permission for recording.

labels.0: not recalled, incorrect or not scorable

scoring_schema.missing_value_rule: Use null only when the task was not feasible, not administered or was inaccessible; record the reason separately.
scoring_schema.scorer_instruction: Score against a pre-registered answer key while blind to condition where practical; do not score agreement, liking or trust.

analysis_plan: Report item-level and aggregate comprehension/recall with uncertainty and missingness.
Compare conditions within stimulus and, where possible, within participant.
Inspect null results, reversals, topic interactions and accessibility failures.
Pre-register primary task and exclusions before unblinding.
Treat results as local to the authored stimuli and tested population until replicated.
not_run_reason: No matched stimulus pairs or consented listener observations are present.
